title: FL Studio Beat Maker/ Producer
description:
## Job Description



We are looking for an experienced FL Studio producer to join our growing music production team. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who is highly skilled in creating professional-quality instrumentals from scratch.



**Important:** We are **not** looking for producers who rely on pre-made loops or construction kits. We are looking for musicians and producers who understand composition, music theory, and professional production techniques.



### Responsibilities



* Create original custom beats from scratch in FL Studio.

* Compose original melodies, chord progressions, basslines, and drum arrangements.

* Produce beats in a variety of modern styles including Hip-Hop, Trap, Cinematic, K-Pop Rap, Drill, Pop, and Sync-ready music.

* Make revisions based on creative feedback.

  * Keys

  * Chord progressions

  * Harmony

  * Melody writing

  * Song structure

* Ability to create original compositions without relying on loops.

* Strong sound selection and arrangement skills.

* Basic to intermediate mixing skills, including:



  * Level balancing

  * EQ

  * Compression

  * Stereo placement

  * Creating clean, professional-sounding beats

* Experience exporting stems and properly organizing project files.



### Preferred Qualifications



* Experience producing music for sync licensing, television, film, or commercial placements.

* Ability to work across multiple genres while maintaining commercial-quality production.

* Fast turnaround times.

* Strong attention to detail.



### To Apply



Please include:



* A portfolio of your best original productions.

* FL Studio project screenshots (optional but encouraged).

* Examples of beats created entirely from scratch (no construction kits or pre-made loops).

* Your experience with music theory and composition.

* Your typical turnaround time for one custom beat.



We are looking to build long-term relationships with talented producers who are passionate about creating world-class music. If you're a skilled producer who understands both the creative and technical side of music production, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Stylist & Wardrobe Curator (Hourly, Temporary)
description:
About the Role

I’m looking for a thoughtful, fashion-minded virtual stylist to help me bring order, creativity, and fresh vision to my existing wardrobe. I’ve already photographed my clothes, shoes, bags, and jewelry. Now, I need your eye to help me put it all together.



This is a remote position where you’ll help me create styled looks for different parts of my life: speaking engagements, church services, real estate client meetings, casual outings, travel days, and formal events. We’ll use the Indyx iOS app to build and organize my wardrobe, and I’ll cover the premium subscription if needed.



You won’t need to shop for me or build a wardrobe from scratch. I simply need help refining and coordinating what I already own into outfits that are appropriate, elegant, and true to who I am.



A Little About Me



I’m a minister, real estate broker, and author based in Tennessee. I show up in many different spaces — from pulpits to closing tables to Sunday brunch — and I want my wardrobe to reflect confidence, modesty, purpose, and grace. My style is a blend of sophistication and professionalism, with a touch of Afrocentric flair.



What You’ll Be Doing:

Access my wardrobe photos inside the Indyx app and help me organize them by category, color, and occasion

Create polished and appropriate outfits for specific events like:



Sunday services

Real estate closings and networking

Speaking engagements (in person and virtual)

Brunch or lunch with friends

Travel and formal events

Build lookbooks and mood boards in the app so I can easily find what to wear

Tag each item and outfit with helpful details like occasion, season, and location

Suggest styling adjustments, accessory pairings, or layering options

Use the app’s built-in photo editor to clean up background images and help the catalog look its best

Provide brief notes or explanations for each outfit so I understand how to pull it together myself



What I’m Looking For:



Someone with experience in styling, wardrobe curation, or fashion coordination

A person who understands how to work with modest, professional, ministry-appropriate clothing

Comfortable using iOS and willing to work inside the Indyx app (training provided if needed)

Organized and good at communicating clearly and kindly

Someone who enjoys helping others look and feel their best

Bonus if you have experience building digital lookbooks or working with speakers or professionals

Details:



This is a short-term project paid by the hour

Please include your hourly rate when you apply



We’ll begin with a paid trial task (such as styling 3 to 5 looks) and move from there



I’d love to get started right away, with the project expected to last around 3 to 4 weeks, depending on how we pace it



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your styling background

Your hourly rate

Any examples of work you’ve done; especially for clients who speak, teach, or lead professionally

Confirmation that you use an iOS device and are open to working inside the Indyx app

Semrush

Organic traffic growth

Keyword ranking improvements

Opportunities for continued growth

Marketing team

Cloudflare

Schema.org

title: AI Video Editor & Prompt Creator (CapCut + Higgsfield)
description:
We create AI-generated TikTok Shop videos for beauty and skincare products.



We're looking for someone who can generate AI footage in Higgsfield, edit it in CapCut, and write strong hooks that stop people from scrolling.



We provide the product photos, Higgsfield Team account, AI tokens, and training. You bring the prompting skills, editing skills, and creative ideas.



THE ROLE

You'll create short TikTok videos (around 10 seconds) by:

Generating AI clips in Higgsfield

Editing them together in CapCut

Writing strong on-screen hooks

The biggest challenge is keeping the same AI character consistent across every scene. If the character changes between clips, the video doesn't work.

Most videos follow one of two formats:



Before ? After transformation

Celebrity angle ("I took their advice on...")



REFERENCE VIDEOS

These are not our videos. They're examples of the style and quality we're looking for.









We're looking for:

- Consistent AI characters

- Natural-looking footage

- Strong hooks

- Fast-paced editing



WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

- Experience with AI image or video tools (Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, Midjourney, or similar)

-Strong CapCut skills

-Fluent written English

-Good instincts for hooks and short-form content

-A reliable computer, stable internet, and consistent availability



We'll train you on Higgsfield, our workflow, and our compliance rules. We can't train someone who's completely new to AI prompting.



WHAT YOU WON'T DO

No strategy, analytics, account management, or product selection. Your focus is creating videos.



HOURS & PAY

-Part-time (2-5 hours/day)

-Flexible schedule

-$5-10 USD/hour depending on experience, Bi- weekly payment via Wise

-Paid trial week

-Long-term role (12+ months)

-Hiring ASAP!



HOW TO APPLY

1. Put LEMON at the very top of your application.

2. Send ONE AI-generated image or video you've created (rough is completely fine) and tell us which AI tool you used.



Applications missing either step won't be reviewed.
